name: MSD Clock - Alarm & Reminder Dashboard
description: Advanced Clock Dashboard with Alarms, Reminders, Stopwatch, World Clock, and Voice Features. Set alarms, create reminders, track time zones, and use voice assistant with English and Malayalam support.
